storage_allocation_policy.notes: User clarified that the 4TB-class HDD may be used for up to about 3.8 decimal TB of worthwhile archive. This does not waive the independently checked free-space floor. If formatted volume cannot satisfy both, actual allowed archive bytes will be smaller; do not invent capacity.

user_reported_capacity.reported_text: about 3.8 TB displayed/usable on a purchased 4 TB-class HDD
user_reported_capacity.unit_and_meaning: not independently verified; TB vs TiB, total vs free, and exact bytes unknown

inference_operational_cost_policy.priority: secondary to S1-S2-S3 regulatory forecast; mandatory before manifest approval

total_parameter_policy.scope: every model for portfolio acceptance, including quantized variants or MoE; datasets are exempt from model parameter limit
total_parameter_policy.compare_field: total model parameters (all experts, active+inactive; include independently loaded core components as stated by publisher)
total_parameter_policy.rule_if_at_or_above: HARD_EXCLUDE >=150B total (including inactive MoE experts, learned embedding, MTP, and original model components), no weights/lock/download
total_parameter_policy.rule_if_below: Passes total-parameter gate only; continue 512GB infer RAM, 3.8TB archival budget, free-space, rights, manifest checks
total_parameter_policy.rule_if_unknown: BLOCK_FINAL_LOCK_AND_APPROVAL; source-backed total count required, do not guess from 125B core / model name alone
total_parameter_policy.magnitude_unit: total trained parameters as dimensionless count, B=10^9; exact threshold 150000000000
total_parameter_policy.change_reason: User explicitly changed former 250B exclusion to 150B inclusive exclusion; stricter upper limit.
